svg.title: SQL in your browser, code and data on your machine—with Iroh
svg.desc: Haybarn in the browser sends vgi-rpc calls and receives Arrow data over Iroh. Browser traffic passes through a relay and is encrypted to the remote Iroh endpoint. On your computer, a bridge connects to a VGI worker, or a Grainlift gateway connects to a database through its native ADBC driver. These are two alternative endpoints.

g.aria-label: Code and data on your machine.
No public HTTPS endpoint. No worker certificate renewals.
Reach your code and databases by endpoint ID.
